analytics.conditions: single crystal structure determination at -170 deg C, wavelength 1.54178 Angstrom
analytics.raw_text: Single crystal structure of form A: orthorhombic, space group Pna2(1). The table at lines 124-138, repeated at 143-157, gives thirteen parameters - crystal class, space group, the three unit cell lengths a, b and c in Angstrom, the three unit cell angles all 90 deg, the cell volume in Angstrom cubed, Z, the calculated density in Mg/m cubed, the two R factors and the wavelength.

notes: Crystalline form A of tembotrione: the same molecule as tembotrione, differing only in crystal lattice, and not a distinct chemical entity. Formula C17H16ClF3O6S. This record is form A. The section is a single crystal structure table for form A and names no other substance; the space group symbol Pna2(1), the cell axes and angles, the volume, Z, the density, the R factors and the wavelength are measurements, not compounds. is_section_product is false because this section only characterises the form and no step of it produces anything. The table heading is printed twice on line 123, a duplication artifact of the vision transcription rather than two tables.
